close_reason: Updated README Known Limitations: removed 'known gap' framing; batch_destroy_emails already exists as optional MailBackend method with default loop; backends should override for O(1) cascade.
description:
The jmap-mail-server README Known Limitations section currently states:

'onDestroyRemoveEmails cascade is O(N) per destroyed mailbox. [...] A batch backend method would reduce this to O(1) calls. This is a known gap in the MailBackend API surface.'

This is inaccurate. batch_destroy_emails already exists as an optional MailBackend trait method with a default implementation that loops (see src/backend.rs). Backends can override it with a single batched query to achieve O(1) calls. The 'known gap' framing is wrong.

Fix: Update the README bullet to accurately state:
- batch_destroy_emails exists as an optional MailBackend method
- The DEFAULT implementation is O(N) (calls destroy_object in a loop)
- Backends that need O(1) cascade behavior should override batch_destroy_emails with a single bulk-delete operation
- Link to the MailBackend trait section of the same README for the method signature

Acceptance criteria:
- README no longer claims batch_destroy_emails is a 'known gap'
- README accurately describes the default O(N) behavior and the override path
- No code changes
title: jmap-mail-server: Correct README — batch_destroy_emails already exists in MailBackend
